candidate.answerReason: State tax is 10% of the remaining 80%, or 8% of the original inheritance. Total taxes are therefore 28%, so the inheritance is 10500/0.28 = 37500 dollars, agreeing with D.

methods.label: Express both taxes as percentages of the inheritance
methods.explanation:
The two tax rates apply to different amounts. After the federal tax, \(80\%\) of the inheritance remains. The state tax is \(10\%\) of that remainder, so as a fraction of the original inheritance it is
\[
0.10\cdot0.80=0.08=8\%.
\]
Together, the taxes take \(20\%+8\%=28\%\) of the inheritance. Since this equals \(10{,}500\) dollars, the original inheritance was
\[
\frac{10{,}500}{0.28}=37{,}500\text{ dollars},
\]
choice D.
